Study Title:AI Use in Software Engineering Education

You are invited to take part in a research study conducted by researchers from the University of California, Santa Cruz studying how students use generative AI tools in software engineering coursework.

Before you decide whether or not to participate in the survey, you should read this form and email questions if there is anything that you do not understand. Contact information is provided below.


Purpose:  The purpose of this survey is to study how students use generative AI tools (such as ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, Claude, or similar systems) while working on software engineering projects. The study specifically examines how AI tools are used during different stages of the software development lifecycle (such as planning, design, implementation, testing, and deployment) in course-based team projects.


Decision to Quit at Any Time:

Your participation is completely voluntary. You are free to change your mind at any time and quit the study. You may also skip any question that you do not wish to answer.

Whatever you decide will in no way penalize you or result in loss of benefits or services to which you are otherwise entitled. Your decision to participate or not participate will not affect your grade, standing in the course, or relationship with your instructors**.

You may exit the survey at any time by closing the survey window.

-

What You Will Do in the Study: If you decide to take part in this study, you will complete a brief questionnaire about your experiences using generative AI tools in your software engineering coursework.

The survey includes questions about:


How you use AI tools in software development tasks

How easy or useful AI tools are during different development stages
*
How AI tools are integrated into your development workflow


You may also optionally be asked to provide your GitHub username so that researchers can analyze repository activity related to course projects. 

Providing your GitHub username is optional, and you may leave this question blank.


Time Required

Participation in this survey is estimated to take approximately 5–7 minutes.


Extra Credit

Students who complete the survey may receive 2 points of extra credit in the course, as determined by the instructor.

Students who choose not to participate in the survey will be provided with an alternative opportunity to earn equivalent extra credit.


 Risks or Discomforts:  No significant risks are expected from participating in this study. The survey questions focus on experiences with AI tools in coursework.

If you choose to provide your GitHub username, this information may be considered identifiable. The research team will take steps to protect the confidentiality of this information.

As with any internet-based survey, there is a small risk that data transmitted online could be intercepted by a third party. However, the survey content is not expected to pose risks to your reputation, livelihood, or well-being.

Researchers have protective measures in place to protect your data.

Benefits of this Study

There are no direct personal benefits to participating in this study.

However, the results of the study may help researchers and educators better understand how generative AI tools are used in software engineering education and how they affect software development practices in student projects.

 Confidentiality:

The information that you give in this survey will be handled confidentially.

If you provide your GitHub username, it will only be used for research purposes related to this study and will not be shared publicly. Identifiable research data will be stored in encrypted and password-protected systems accessible only to the research team.

While researchers follow procedures to maintain confidentiality, as with any internet activity we cannot guarantee the confidentiality of data transmitted online.


Survey responses will be analyzed and reported in aggregate form, and individual participants will not be identified in publications or presentations resulting from this study.
